fixture: Explicit tiny reviewed launch.py initializes Git with fixed synthetic identity/dates, commits fixture, modifies only seed.txt, then execs real Lazygit. No remote or target-screen substitution.
regression: Apply target-regression.patch; stage method invokes reset rather than add. Unchanged stage state assertion fails; restore binary to recover.
oracles: After reviewed capture and before teardown, inspect real staged blob via git show :seed.txt; discarded worktree bytes; commit subject/content/clean status. Initial captures confirmed staged filename and commit subject; strengthened blob/clean checks separately reverified.

findings.detail: Redundant focus key did not change state; recorder correctly rejected a stale diff anchor. Removed idempotent focus step, asserted genuinely staged state.

exclusions: remote operations, credentials, hooks, signing, clipboard and destructive confirmation acceptance
portability: Actual target resolved by PATH from explicit owned build directory; setup writes directory to GITHUB_PATH in workflow and user_journeys sets the same reviewed runtime_path. Removed operator-specific absolute executable argument; final qualification and mutation checks use this portable contract.
maintenance: Explicit separate control shows a declared user input/selection change as snapshot mismatch, inspects changed state, performs selected baseline update and ordinary replay; original primary baseline remains unchanged. Evidence in reports/maintenance-summary.json after final execution.
fixture_portability: Before initial Git commit, explicitly normalize only the three owned synthetic fixture files to LF bytes and mode 0755. Actual Git regression from 0644/LF and 0755/CRLF inputs yields identical final commits; reports/fixture-mode-regression.json. Only changed synthetic commit hashes were deliberately reviewed in named snapshots; target regression/recovery and 30 final passes repeated afterward.
